title: Ops Lantern: compact exec signal brief and runway adjuster for monthly roadmap sync
creator: Priya Nandakumar
description: Create a compact, data-driven executive brief (Ops Lantern) that synthesizes roadmap health, runway exposure, and consequence lanes for the monthly product+eng exec sync and QBR prep. The deliverable is a 6-slide PDF + one-pager that: (1) surfaces top 3 risks to roadmap delivery and inference economics, (2) presents contingency lanes with clear trigger thresholds, and (3) proposes resource or scope adjustments to keep SLAs and OKRs intact.
objectives: Produce a 6-slide Ops Lantern exec brief summarizing initiative health across OKRs and key metrics
Define measurable trigger thresholds for each contingency lane (capacity, latency, cost)
Align cross-functional owners to recommended runway adjustments and decision gates
Ship a one-pager for the board pre-read and exec circulation before monthly sync
decisions: Adopt three consequence lanes (Scale Back, Reallocate, Escalate) with numeric triggers defined for cost/unit and 95th latency
Prioritize runtime-optimizations (kernel and batching) as Tier 1 mitigation for inference econ before feature deferral
Use Dedicated pool burst capacity as temporary relief (finance approval required) rather than immediate model quantization across the fleet
